messages.help.mode: FULL KOReader + books + reading data; KOREADER whole directory only; LIBRARY files only; AUDIT without writes.

messages.help.target_model: Physical TARGET model label; still requires confirmation.

messages.help.locale: Interface locale tag (en, zh-Hant or zh-Hans); otherwise detect the terminal preference.
messages.help.list_locales: List registered interface locales without connecting a Kobo or creating runs.
messages.help.preview_ui: Show a read-only translated menu sample; no devices, logs or runs are accessed.
messages.preview.title: KOReader migration: interface preview

messages.mode.full: Entire KOReader + ebooks + reading data + root fonts by default.
